contentList.content: Vludber directs the game from behind his screen. Attacks against him have Advantage, and all damage he takes is halved. A critical failure passes the screen: each one removes [1]% of his maximum hit points.
When a creature critically fails an attack against Vludber, he answers with an insult for [1]. The same failure removes [2]% of his maximum hit points.
Vludber has cursed your dice. Your Attack Rolls always critically fail. Each failure deals [1] to you and removes [2]% of Vludber's maximum hit points.
Vludber has prepared his Final Number and can now perform it.
Vludber performs his greatest number, once per combat. Each enemy within [1] must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw or take [2]. On a save, they take half damage.
